title: Seven equivalent Koszul criteria for connected strongly graded corings over a semisimple base ring
author: Adrian Manea; Dragoș Ștefan
work: Further Properties and Applications of Koszul Pairs
source_version: Official SIGMA 12 (2016) article 092, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2016.092; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The nontrivial direction constructs exactness of the quadratic Koszul comodule complex from diagonal Ext by induction and dimension shifting. It controls successive cokernels through strong grading and reduces their injectivity to the first possible internal degree, where the quadratic relations provide an explicit boundary. These comodule-resolution and bigraded homological obligations exceed the usual field-level quadratic-dual slogan.

source_check.note: The complete original seven-way Koszul-coring characterization Theorem 4.4 and all new required comodule proof are supplied over the standing semisimple bimodule base. The normalized bigraded Ext algebra, shriek ring, almost-Koszul complex and explicit comparison map are fully defined. New strong-grading/primitive Hom tests, injective-resolution splicing, dimension shifting, cokernel grading and the explicit first-internal-degree quadratic boundary give the difficult diagonal-Ext-to-exactness direction. The comparison theorem completes the canonical E(C)-to-C! isomorphism; named previously established six-complex equivalence and bar-comparison facts remain cited background. Original boundary indices are preserved with the original metadata notice. No ring-side characterization, graded-dual/poset application, local finiteness or field substitution is counted. Existing approved human statement/proof/context/above-qualification decision copied from the frozen manifest and metadata; no new source or mathematical review.

Source final boundary display uses d_r^n where the immediately described quotient is by Im d_r^(n-1); original formula is preserved and its context fixes the boundary degree. No graded-dual, poset or ring-side neighbor counted.

original_metadata.statement_scope: R semisimple, C a connected N-graded strongly graded R-coring (all graded coproduct components injective).
